events.title: Woodstock '69 anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began in Bethel, New York, drawing hundreds of thousands for '3 Days of Peace & Music'.

angles.name: Woodstock legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since the iconic festival, what's your ultimate Woodstock anthem?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away at Graceland aged 42; he would have been 91 this year.

angles.name: Elvis's enduring reign
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since we lost the King, Elvis Presley's music still reigns supreme. What's your go-to track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas in 1996; he would have been 55 this year.

angles.name: Tupac's impact
angles.copy: Thirty years since his untimely passing, Tupac Shakur's lyrics and legacy continue to resonate. What's your favourite Tupac track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Guitar legend Jimi Hendrix passed away in London in 1970, aged 27; he would have been 84 this year.

angles.name: Jimi's guitar genius
angles.copy: Fifty-six years on, Jimi Hendrix's groundbreaking guitar work still inspires. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' in 1969, featuring tracks like 'Come Together' and 'Here Comes the Sun'.

angles.name: Abbey Road icon
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles crossed that famous road. What's your favourite track from 'Abbey Road'?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde's voice
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude are as iconic as ever. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam G's swagger
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing the swagger and the tunes. What's your top Oasis or solo track?

events.title: Imagine album anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his seminal solo album 'Imagine' in 1971, featuring the iconic title track.

angles.name: Imagine's message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. The album's message of peace and unity feels as vital as ever.

events.title: iPod launch anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember '1,000 songs in your pocket'? Twenty-five years ago, the first iPod changed everything. What was on your first playlist?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global celebration of the James Bond film franchise, marking the premiere of Dr. No in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, what's your all-time favourite 007 moment or song?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's enduring spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled talent of John Lennon. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic Monty Python and Fawlty Towers star John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Cleese's comic genius
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From silly walks to hotel mayhem, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: White Album anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: White Album diversity
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unveiled their diverse 'White Album'. Which track from this sprawling masterpiece is your favourite?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away in 1991, aged 45; he would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Freddie's showmanship
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?
